newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Baan to issue conv. bonds. [CORRECTED 08:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Baan to issue conv. bonds. [CORRECTED 08:05 GMT]

text.p: Computer software firm Baan Company said on Thursday it was planning to issue at least $160 million worth of convertible subordinated bonds.

"Depending on market circumstances Baan is planning to issue some $160 million -- or a higher amount in case of a possible green shoe (over-allotment) option -- in convertible subordinated bonds and offer those to institutional investors in and ouside the United States," Baan said in a statement.
It is expected that the bonds will be listed in Amsterdam and on the PORTAL market in the U.S.
The proceeds of the bonds will be used as working capital, Baan said.
The bonds will be convertible into ordinary shares at any time after 90 days and will have a life of five years.
(Corrects to show five-year bonds can be converted after 90 days.)
The issue will not be registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933.
